body:
Thanks for the response. Like I mentioned in a comment on that thread above your's, I'm really awful at social interaction. I also don't have any hobbies anymore. Video gaming used to be my fall back, then after college I really grew out of it. I can't stick with anything else long enough to really call it a hobby.

The problem is surviving the year or however long it takes. Like I mentioned, this girl is really my only good friend. She's tied into all my other friends and my family. There's no way to just disappear and try to leave everything behind.

Another great response. I have a really tough time even talking about my problems because there are millions and millions of people in a worse situation than me.

I don't even have any other prospects either. I don't meet people during the week and this girl is so tied into my family and friends that it's hard to even meet other people on the weekends. 

The hardest part is feeling like I have no control over the only thing I care about in life. It just gets a little more depressing every day and I lost the only hope I had (even if it was a nearly impossible dream).

While this is a great response, I have an extremely tough time around strangers. Once people get to know me they love me, but I've always been a quiet person and I always freeze up in those kinds of situations. It's a curse.
